title: The joy of the Lord is my strength

lines.text: The joy of the LORD is my strength and shield,
The joy of the LORD is my strength and shield,
The joy of the LORD is my strength and shield,
Oh, the joy of the LORD is my strength.
He gives me living water and I thirst no more,
He gives me living water and I thirst no more,
He gives me living water and I thirst no more
For the joy of the LORD is my strength.
If you want joy you must sing for it,
If you want joy you must sing for it,
If you want joy you must sing for it,
For the joy of the LORD is my strength.
